task_definition.task_description: Please check whether AA100 is on time, prepare my flight details for Jordan Lee in economy, and then get the New York weather alert and publish a high-priority travel advisory to my app. After that, look up Hilton Tokyo, prepare an availability request for a deluxe room for Jordan Lee from 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-13, and then book it; then check my checking account status, assess the risk for a $28,785 trade, prepare a request to sell 5 shares of AAPL at the current $100 quote, and place the sell order.
